name: Gecko Adhesion Pads
description: Modifies the skin of the palms, fingers, and soles of the feet to produce microscopic setae — the hair-like structures that allow geckos to climb vertical surfaces through van der Waals forces. The user can adhere to and climb smooth vertical surfaces including glass, metal, and polished stone, supporting their full body weight through hand and foot contact alone. The adhesion is dry — no sticky residue — and controllable through deliberate toe and finger peeling motions. Premium installations from Crucible Genomics include forearm and shin pad integration for increased contact area and load capacity. The modification leaves the palms and soles with a distinctive velvety texture that is immediately identifiable on contact. Wall walkers are valued in construction, maintenance, and emergency response — and feared in the security profession, since adhesion-climbing bypasses most physical barriers.
procedure: Dermal modification of palms and soles with setae induction, 3 sessions
expression_time: 4–6 weeks; climbing technique requires 2–3 months of training
reversibility: Reversible with setae ablation; skin texture returns to normal over 3–4 months
side_effects: Palms and soles have distinctive velvety texture — identifiable by touch
Adhesion fails when surfaces are wet, dusty, or oily
Gloves and shoes interfere with adhesion — climbing requires bare skin contact
Grip becomes involuntary during sleep — users stick to bedsheets
Carrying capacity limited by arm and leg strength, not adhesion — you can hold the wall but your muscles still tire
social_perception: Cool and practical. Wall Walkers are admired for their ability and slightly mistrusted by property owners and security professionals. The modification is popular among younger demographics who use the city's vertical surfaces as playgrounds.
story_hooks: A Wall Walker discovers a hidden entrance 40 floors up on a building's exterior — a door accessible only to climbers, leading somewhere that wasn't on any blueprint
A Gecko Mod user is accused of a high-rise break-in based on palm-texture forensics left on a window — but they were framed by someone who reproduced their setae pattern on synthetic climbing gloves
related_entities: Zheng-Dao Heavy Industries Gecko Ascender GA-4
